title: calycomelia quadrangulata
intro: Calycomelia quadrangulata, commonly known as the "Four-angled calycomelia" or "Four-angled milkwort," is a species of flowering plant in the family Boraginaceae. This plant has been utilized in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, offering health benefits such as soothing digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
